english.title: Use an excluded vehicle in the Mersey Tunnels
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), was the driver of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), within the Mersey Tunnels, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TUNNEL..) which was excluded from use of the tunnels, namely

(A)_[a public service vehicle carrying passengers in excess of the authorised number]_
(B)_[a vehicle which emitted smoke, visible vapour, grit, sparks, ashes, cinders or an oily substance]_
(C)_[a vehicle which contravened regulations relating to the construction and use of motor vehicles, namely **(..SPECIFY THE CONTRAVENTION..)]_
(D)_[a vehicle which was of such a size or shape that it would not clear the structure or fixtures of the tunnel]_
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 8 and 16 of the Mersey Tunnels Byelaws 2003.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
drove an excluded vehicle within the Mersey Tunnels namely
a PSV carrying passengers in excess of the authorised number OR
a vehicle which emitted smoke / visible vapour / grit / sparks / ashes / cinders / oily substance OR
a vehicle which contravened regulations relating to the construction and use of m/vehicles OR
a vehicle which was of such a size / shape that it would not clear the structure / fixtures of the tunnel
